name: finals_2026
source: Built from mandates/rules_2026.json (first challenge) and updated to the Final Challenge Instructions PDF, which governs (data/organisers)
holdings_spec: date, identifier, weight for every rebalancing date (Arcana's file guide sets the layout)

units.short_min_market_cap: US$ millions, as the panel's me

quotes.nav_start: p4: US$1 billion endowed at the start of the out-of-sample period; the fund compounds from there
quotes.names_min: p4: At least 200 and at most 500 names, long and short legs combined
quotes.names_max: p4: At least 200 and at most 500 names, long and short legs combined
quotes.gross: p4: Up to 200% of capital (leverage of at most 2×)
quotes.net_band: p4: Within −50% to +50% at all times; dollar neutrality is the natural centre
quotes.short_min_market_cap: p4: Only names with market capitalisation ≥ US$500m, measured at the formation date
quotes.name_cap: p4: Maximum 5% of capital in any one name
quotes.lag_days: p15: information dated through day t forms the book at the close of day t+1, and the first return you earn on it is the close of t+1 to the close of t+2
quotes.holdings_spec: p24: Holdings file: date, identifier, weight, for every rebalancing date in the out-of-sample period
quotes.benchmark_path: p20: b_t = TB3MS_t / 1200 + 0.04 / 12 ... the daily equivalent is b_t = TB3MS_t / 25200 + 0.04 / 252
quotes.benchmark_premium: p4: 3-month U.S. Treasury bill + 4% per year, computed month by month
